📺 Law & Order: Special Victims Unit (1999–Present)

Law & Order: Special Victims Unit follows an elite team of detectives within the New York City Police Department who investigate sexually based offenses, domestic violence, child abuse, and other sensitive criminal cases. At the center of the series is Olivia Benson, a compassionate and determined detective who dedicates her career to protecting vulnerable victims and bringing offenders to justice. Alongside her longtime partner Elliot Stabler, experienced detective Fin Tutuola, and other dedicated investigators, Benson confronts emotionally challenging cases that often reveal disturbing secrets and complicated moral dilemmas. As the team gathers evidence, interviews witnesses, and works with prosecutors, they must also manage the emotional toll of their demanding profession. Starring Mariska Hargitay, Christopher Meloni, and Ice-T, the series delivers gripping investigations, powerful performances, and thought-provoking storytelling while exploring justice, trauma, resilience, compassion, accountability, and the importance of giving survivors a voice.

🎭 Genre: Crime • Drama • Mystery • Police Procedural

⭐ IMDb: 8.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 43 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creator: Dick Wolf

📍 Setting: New York City.

🏆 Awards: Winner of multiple Primetime Emmy Awards, including Outstanding Lead Actress in a Drama Series for Mariska Hargitay.

📚 Franchise: A spin-off of the original Law & Order series and one of the longest-running scripted primetime dramas in American television history.

📺 Where to Watch: NBC • Peacock (United States)
